title: When the Scholarship Burns
author: Dominic Ravensworth
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
